description: Hola es mi primera vez participando en Space Apps y vengo con muchísimas ganas de hacer un buen trabajo. Tengo la motivación de quien quiere aprender y darlo todo. Cuido la documentación y el pitch, y soy comprometida, rápida y directa. Hagámoslo bien.
summary:
AstroGram is an interactive web platform designed to make NASA's SPHEREx astronomical observations accessible to everyone.

Developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, AstroGram allows users to enter sky coordinates, retrieve real infrared images from NASA/IPAC IRSA, and compare observations from different epochs through an interactive blink viewer. This makes it easier to visually identify potential moving objects and changes in the night sky.

The platform also features experimental motion detection, non-destructive FITS image processing, and a social community where astronomy enthusiasts can share observations, discuss findings, and collaborate.

By combining scientific visualization with social interaction, AstroGram transforms complex astronomical data into an accessible, educational, and collaborative experience, encouraging public participation in space exploration.
details:
AstroGram is an interactive astronomy platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It allows users to explore real SPHEREx observations from NASA/IPAC IRSA, compare infrared images from different epochs, and identify potential changes in the sky.

The platform includes a FITS image viewer, experimental motion detection, non-destructive image processing, and social features for sharing discoveries and collaborating with other astronomy enthusiasts.

Built with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL, AstroGram makes astronomical data more accessible to students, amateur astronomers, and the public.

Our goal is to turn complex scientific observations into an engaging, educational, and collaborative experience.

Try AstroGram: https://astrogram.up.railway.app/
